name: Masters of Gaia
detailed_description:
Embrace Your Divine Role

In Masters of Gaia, step into the role of a deity with unparalleled power over the natural world. Shape landscapes, summon rivers, ignite volcanoes, and unleash lightning to guide your followers' destiny. This modern god game revitalizes a genre where your influence is vast, but control is indirect.

A Living, Breathing World

Your followers are autonomous beings, evolving and expanding their civilizations without direct commands. They will cultivate lands, build structures, and interact with their environment based on their needs and ambitions. Your divine interventions—whether nurturing or destructive—will steer their development and survival.

Balance Progress and Nature

As your followers advance, their activities may disrupt the natural balance—deforestation, pollution, and overexpansion can awaken Gaia's fury. Neglecting the environment can lead to natural disasters like earthquakes, floods, and storms, serving as reminders of nature's supremacy. Strive to harmonize human progress with ecological preservation to maintain stability.

Dynamic Challenges

Beyond environmental concerns, your followers will face seasonal changes, unpredictable weather, rival clans, and mythical creatures such as dragons. Your strategic influence will be crucial in helping them navigate these challenges, ensuring their resilience and prosperity.

Key Features:

  • Divine Terrain Manipulation: Sculpt mountains, carve rivers, grow forests, and summon volcanoes to shape the world.

  • Autonomous Civilizations: Witness your followers develop independently, reacting to the environment and your interventions.

  • Environmental Consequences: Monitor the impact of civilization on nature and mitigate Gaia's wrath through careful balance.

  • Dynamic Challenges: Guide your followers through changing seasons, harsh weather, rival tribes, and legendary monsters.

  • Strategic Influence: Employ a variety of divine powers to support, punish, or redirect your followers without direct control.

Reviving the God Game Genre

Masters of Gaia breathes new life into the god game genre, offering players the thrill of omnipotence coupled with the challenge of indirect control. Fans of classics like Populous, Black & White, and From Dust will find familiar themes reimagined for a contemporary gaming experience.

Will You Be a Benevolent Guardian or a Vengeful Deity?

The fate of your followers and the world they inhabit rests in your hands. Nurture their growth with compassion or discipline them with nature's fury. In Masters of Gaia, the choice is yours, and the consequences are profound.

short_description: Forge the world, guide your people, and survive Gaia’s judgment. Masters of Gaia is a modern god game where you shape the land, unleash divine powers, and influence growing civilizations—while keeping nature in balance to ensure their lasting survival.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD RX 580 (8 GB)
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
